effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with [Veemon] or [Veedramon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon unsuspend, by suspending this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.). After, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
